view.title: STO frontier after e5ba65062178, PhaseProduct, n = 2048, delta = 0.01
view.width_rule: Exact widths: at every node the child width is the least width at which every reachable intermediate register value and every child operand fits, over the floor-limb box (no padding). PhaseProduct: ShorTableOptimization's exact_width (Lean Tight.lean: the least overflow-free width, never above the scan); PhaseTripleProduct: the PTP suite's ptp_tight_width (Lean PTP/Exact.lean). The board derives these widths itself; a submitted width ladder is ignored. Python equals Lean is cross-checked (34 policies, every seed's Lean run), not proved.
view.qubits_label: static-layout formula at exact widths (not Lean-proved)
view.qubits_rule: static layout 2w + Rx + Rz evaluated at the exact child widths (Lean's Policy.reserveNeed recurrence, PolicyWorkspace.lean); Lean proves this layout at the scanned widths only, so at exact widths it is a formula, not a Lean-proved layout. Cross-checks: the Lean-proved static layout of the same policy at ForShor scanned widths (qubits_lean_static_scan) and Qualtran's QubitCount peak (qubits_qualtran_peak)
